findings.diagnosis: The pattern is one of names a general shape the section has been assembling from three examples, which is what a section built on evidence is for. Here, intelligence serves confines the claim to the projects just named. The appositive is also the sentence's proof: the same data infrastructure, repurposed, is why the pattern counts as evidence for the substrate principle, and split off with a new subject it becomes an additional observation. The same in the same data infrastructure is what carries the identity.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.23 read onto the argument the book has been making.
findings.diagnosis: What is most interesting is a judgment the narrator makes and owns, and the volume card sets the stance as first person editorial witness joined to philosophical diagnosis. The central question in this field asserts that the field itself has a central question, which is a claim about the field rather than about the book's interest in it. From the perspective of the argument the book has been making is also genuine wayfinding, which 4.23's retention limb preserves in a long philosophical work, because it tells the reader which of several possible interests is being applied.

evidence.shipped: A parallel pattern appears in AI-based biodiversity monitoring ... catalogued more than 250 active digital systems ... Technical capability is advancing faster than the institutional capacity ... noted severe taxonomic gaps ... rather than external developers ... This work is fragile and uneven ... Yet genuinely people-centered deployments demonstrate

findings.diagnosis: The work being done with AI for biodiversity monitoring names human labour; AI-based biodiversity monitoring names a technique. Noted that taxonomic gaps remain severe reports what a study said and keeps remain, which is the temporal claim; noted severe taxonomic gaps makes the gaps a finding the study observed once. Rather than by external developers preserves the agent in the rejected alternative, which is the sentence's political content. And the existence of genuinely people-centric deployments demonstrates is careful: it is the existence of the counterexample that does the demonstrating, not the deployments themselves.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, both voice cards, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. F2 is the useful case. The pass removed a wayfinding clause under catalog 4.23, and 4.23's retention limb explicitly preserves genuine wayfinding in a long philosophical work. The clause was not announcing what the chapter would do; it was telling the reader which of several available interests the narrator was applying to a body of external evidence, which is exactly the distinction the category draws.
